m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard, look how far you've come in the world since we first met so long ago!
Queen Gwendolyn summons me to the Knight's Hall? Of course!
Hail again. Queen Gwendolyn? It stirs my heart to hear she's rejoined us. Raise the swords and bang the shields!
Oh, hello. Should we be rushing off to fight the Froudlings? That doesn't sound too safe.
Well, I guess if the Queen has requested me, personally...
By the by, do you know if there will be guards at this meeting?
A Knight of the Wyrd, eh? Me too! Lovely people in the Weirwood, the best ever! Well, also the worst critters, I suppose.
Tell Queen Gwendolyn I am thrilled to serve her and follow the Silver Rose again!
The Queen calls? Of course! Morning Star and I will ride into the jaws of death for her! For Artorius and Gwendolyn!
It is wonderful to be here as part of a true knightly order. I am honored to obey the Queen and serve with knights such as you!
I, the Angry Fish, will see you at the Knight's Hall!
Noble Knight, you have risen so high since I first met you! Once a pup, not even a squire, and now a Knight of the Wyrd!
Tell Queen Gwendolyn I will rush to her side! May Avalon thunder again with the voices of the Knights of the Silver Rose!
We called the banners and they all came! This is a great day for us, Wizard!
We will prepare to assist you in taking the fight to the vaunted halls of Castle Avalon and the dread Pendragon itself.
It is time to travel to Lake Nimue to see the Lady of the Lake, the defender of the Sword of Kings, and the spirit of Avalon.
Knight of the Wyrd, I need your aid in rallying the Knights of the Silver Rose! Tell them to come to the Knight's Hall.
Make sure you talk to Sir Pike, Sir Brennan, Sir Robin, Sir Drustan, Sir Jean-Paul, Sir Guy, and the Black Knight in Caliburn.
And don't forget Sir Perry on the High Road. Then meet me in the Knight's Hall.
Tell the Knights to gather. Ready? In Caliburn: Sir Pike del Lago, Sir Brennan Onehand, Sir Guy Gascoigne...
Sir Robin Bravely, Sir Drustan Silverharp, Sir Jean-Paul Jouster, and the Black Knight.
And don't forget Sir Perry Gilliam on the High Road. Once you're done, meet me at the Knight's Hall.
